title.narrative: Enabling lasting change: building policy environments and capacities through which youth can thrive

description.narrative: The activity will support Member States in addressing the exacerbated challenges caused by the polycrisis on youth and in amplifying the agency of youth for positive change, by advancing evidence-informed and inclusive youth policy-making, strengthening public sector capacities on youth issues, and enabling intergenerational dialogue and collaboration. Using its Toolbox on Youth Policy and Programming, UNESCO will provide technical and policy guidance to national governments and stakeholders on how to develop and implement policies affecting youth with the meaningful engagement of youth at all stages of the process. In addition, intergenerational dialogues and trainings will be delivered for the design and roll-out of action plans and programmes advancing holistic youth development and civic engagement, with youth. The aim of this activity is to bridge the gap between non-youth and youth stakeholders at national and local level, and to open avenues for them to jointly construct practical solutions that address the concerns of youth and that enable their participation in decision-making.
